alive.last_commit_message:
docs(site): remove skill-count displays from the catalog

The catalog still rendered counts client-side: a per-plugin total in each
group header (offense · 40) and a '92 skills' tally in the count bar. Both are
gone. Group headers show only the plugin name; the count line now appears only
as search feedback ('3 matches for "kerbe"'), never as a resting total.
Dropped the now-unused per-plugin counts map.

At rest the only numbers on the page are the verification stats (100%
source-verified, 2.6 errors/skill found, 143 ATT&CK techniques) — quality and
coverage, not a skill headcount. Methodology and verification lead.
